query:
WITH deleted AS (
                        DELETE FROM follows
                        WHERE follower_id = $1
                            AND following_id = $2
                        RETURNING 1
                    ),
                    inserted AS (
                        INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, following_id)
                        SELECT $1, $2
                        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted)
                        RETURNING 1
                    )
                    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS "is_following!"
